question: Which 3 products had the highest gross sales in Germany?
sql: SELECT p.description, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE k.country_name = 'Germany' AND NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY p.product_key, p.description ORDER BY gross_sales DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders were placed in 2010?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010 AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: Which 3 countries outside the United Kingdom placed the most orders?
sql: SELECT k.country_name, count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND k.country_name <> 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 products with the most cancelled units.
sql: SELECT p.description, -sum(f.quantity) AS cancelled_units FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE f.is_cancelled GROUP BY p.product_key, p.description ORDER BY cancelled_units DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the net revenue per month in 2010?
sql: SELECT d.month, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many registered customers ordered from France?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.customer_key) AS customers FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE k.country_name = 'France' AND NOT c.is_guest AND NOT f.is_cancelled

question: What was the cancellation rate in 2010 in percent?
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.is_cancelled THEN f.invoice_no END) / count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.is_cancelled THEN f.invoice_no END), 1) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010

question: How many registered customers placed more than 10 orders?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT f.customer_key FROM fact_sales f WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND f.customer_key <> 0 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) > 10)

question: What was the average order value in the United Kingdom?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no), 2) AS aov FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND k.country_name = 'United Kingdom'

question: What share of the 2010 net revenue came from outside the United Kingdom, in percent?
sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN k.country_name <> 'United Kingdom' THEN f.line_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(f.line_amount), 1) AS share_pct FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_country k USING (country_key) JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010

question: What were the gross sales per ISO week in December 2010?
sql: SELECT d.iso_week, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010 AND d.month = 12 AND NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which weekday had the highest gross sales in 2010?
sql: SELECT d.day_name, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2010 AND NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gross_sales DESC LIMIT 1
